dispute_ticket.description: Rider's child dropped food and drink on the rear carpet and tracked dirt in. The rider confirmed it in chat. I had the carpet cleaned for S$50.

chat_logs.content: At T3 arrival pick-up, Level 1, grey Prius.
Your child's snack and mud are all over the rear carpet.
Sorry about that, my son spilled his drink and trod chocolate cake into the carpet. Please send me the cleaning bill and I will pay.

app_events.details: Rider R-7205 booked trip RYDE-IM-005 from Changi Airport Terminal 3 to Bedok Mall.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$50.00 with 1 photo (photo1.jpg). Rider acknowledged the mess in chat at 22:40.
Driver submitted an AutoSpa Bedok receipt for S$50.00 (carpet cleaning) dated 2026-10-10 10:00.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_recipient.text: A cleaning fee charged to a rider is credited to the driver who made the claim.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver should provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt and no other record settles the claim, a case officer decides.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Rear carpet with food crumbs and stains.

expected_outcome.reason: Photo1 carries no capture time, so on its own it cannot be placed inside the 60-minute window (it was uploaded at 22:55, 23 minutes after drop-off at 22:32). The rider settles the point in chat at 22:40: 'my son spilled his drink and trod chocolate cake into the carpet. Please send me the cleaning bill and I will pay.' The AutoSpa Bedok receipt for S$50.00 dated 2026-10-10 10:00 matches the claim, within this trip's S$100 cap. The chat and receipt settle the claim: upheld, S$50.00 credited to the driver.
